item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-10-01
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

2. [Artificial Intelligence] DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
By launching an AI agent for food ordering, DoorDash is looking to gain an edge over rivals Uber Eats and Grubhub.

3. [Tech News] Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
